I've never really tried that. Does StumbleUpon really lead you to sites that pertain to your interests? I get the feeling that it would probably not include really obscure, smaller sites and would instead focus on the bigger ones. Genuinely curious.

I feel like it does. After you make an account, you pick from a big list of several topics you might be interested in (gaming, science, mythology, photography, blahblahblah) and then it dives through the internet finding sites that you might like.

When you hit the stumble button at the top, it takes you to a new page. You can either give that page a thumbs up if you like it and it was what you were looking for, or a thumbs down, and it wont show you pages like that anymore. Once you start thumbs upping or downing each page it learns what you like, and eventually every time you hit the stumble button, it will give you websites you will end up spending hours on. It's pretty nifty.

And yeah it gives you big sites sometimes, but mostly it's only given me sites I have not heard of. It does a good job of finding sites that arent popular.
